tools.name: privi_token_market
tools.description:
PRIVI on Base: price, how much PRIVI and USDC the Privi swap desk holds (so whether a swap can fill),
any Uniswap v3 / Aerodrome pools, and optionally a swap quote. Every paid Privi tool also accepts PRIVI. Free.

tools.name: call_directory
tools.description: List agents you can call, with their numbers. Privi's own agents (100-103) are always free to call.

tools.name: call_list_tools
tools.description: The tools an agent on the network offers, with their input schemas. Free.

tools.name: call_agent
tools.description:
Call a tool on any agent on the Privi Call network and get its answer, with a sealed call record.
No Call routing fee for Privi agents (the target tool charges its own x402 price); calls to other agents
cost $0.001 each from a call key.

tools.name: call_register_agent
tools.description:
Give your MCP server a Privi number so any agent can call it through the network. Free. We check
that it answers tools/list first. Returns the number and a secret to remove it later.

tools.name: call_unregister_agent
tools.description: Take your agent off the Privi Call network.

tools.name: call_credits_buy
tools.description:
1,000 routed calls to any agent for $1.00 USDC, paid with x402 on Base ($0.001 a call). Returns a
call key (pck_...). Call without payment first to get the exact payment requirements.

tools.name: call_credits_balance
tools.description: How many prepaid calls a key has left, and today's free calls.

tools.name: call_log
tools.description:
Recent calls on the network and the phone line, newest first. Each record is hash-chained to the one
before it. Arguments, results and phone transcripts are shown only as SHA-256 hashes.

tools.name: call_verify_log
tools.description: Recompute every hash in the call log and show the latest on-chain checkpoint of its head.

tools.name: call_phone_line
tools.description: The number humans can call to reach the Privi voice agent (pilots, pricing, or the founder).

tools.name: call_do_not_call
tools.description:
Keep your own do-not-call list: add a person who asked not to be called, remove one, or check a number
before dialing. Numbers are stored only as salted hashes.

tools.name: call_hours_check
tools.description:
Is it within calling hours (8 a.m. to 9 p.m.) where the called person is, and if not, when the window
opens next.

tools.name: call_consent_record
tools.description:
Record that a person agreed to marketing calls, an AI voice, call recording or texts. Records are
hash-chained so they cannot be back-filled unnoticed.

tools.name: call_consent_revoke
tools.description:
Record that a person withdrew consent. With no type, every consent is revoked and the number goes on
your do-not-call list.

tools.name: call_consent_check
tools.description: What a person has agreed to, with when and how. With no phone, checks that your consent log is intact.

tools.name: call_precheck
tools.description:
One answer before dialing: is the number on your do-not-call list, is it within calling hours where the
person is, and do you hold the consent this call needs. Returns go / no-go with the reasons.

tools.name: deep_think_plan
tools.description: Plan requirements, testing, risks and edge cases before agent writes code.

tools.name: deep_think_review
tools.description: Log a source hash and five self-reported checks; first submission is free.

tools.name: deep_think_redo
tools.description:
Charge $0.01 only for a genuine, explicitly approved changed code snapshot.

A signed x402 wallet payload in MCP _meta['x402/payment'] is still required.
No permission to spend customer funds is inferred from the agent's claims.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "call_register_agent" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "call_agent" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet:
before: "Call a tool on any agent on the Privi Call network and get its answer, with a sealed call record.
Free to Privi agents; other agents 50 free calls a day, then $0.001 each from a call key." → after: "Call a tool on any agent on the Privi Call network and get its answer, with a sealed call record.
No Call routing fee for Privi agents (the target tool charges its own x402 price); calls to other agents
cost $0.001 each from a call key."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
